title.narrative: Investing for impact against Tuberculosis and HIV - South Africa (01-Apr-2022-30-Sep-2025)

description.narrative: South Africa, TB/HIV, National Department of Health of the Republic of South Africa (NDOH)This program has the following goals: Accelerate prevention to reduce new HIV and TB infections and STIs. Reduce morbidity and mortality by providing treatment, care and adherence support for all. Ground the response to HIV, TB and STIs in human rights principles and approaches. Promote leadership and shared accountability for sustainable response to HIV, TB and STIs. Mobilise resources and maximise efficiencies to support the achievment of NSP goals and ensure a sustainable approach. Strengthen strategic information to drive progress towards achievement of NSP goals. The objectives of this program are: Implement the 95-95-95 Strategy for TB. Increase engagment, collaboration and advocacy of key and vulnerable populations in the development and implementation of social and health support activities. To provide an enabling environment to increase access to health services by key and vulnerable populations. Promote an environment that enables and protects human and legal rights and prevents stigma and discrimination. Strengthen AIDS Councils to provide effective co-ordination and leadership of all stakeholders for shared accountability in the implementation of the NSP. Improve efficiency and mobilise sufficient resources to achieve the goals, objective and targets of the NSP. Optimise routinely collected strategic health information for data utilisation in decision making

Completeness of facility reporting: Percentage of expected facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received

Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
